svg.title: V-23. Life of an installed item (SysML v2 view lifecycle)
svg.desc: SysML action flow diagram generated from the model (LionDriverLifecycle, from WP-S-06 §3). Start leads to installation and provisioning, then operation; operation goes to service or to a software update and back, and ends in decommissioning and done. Each phase is an action of LifecyclePhase containing one ProcedureStep action per requirement TSR-801 to TSR-818, with its ASIL, its status, the procedure steps and record that carry it and the cases that verify it.
